items.quote: This is the offering of Aaron and of his sons, which they shall offer unto the LORD in the day when he is anointed; the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meat offering perpetual, half of it in the morning, and half thereof at night.
items.claim: A perpetual daily offering for Aaron and his sons consists of one-tenth ephah of fine flour, divided equally between morning and evening presentation, commencing on the day of his anointing.
items.object: the tenth part of an ephah of fine flour for a meat offering
items.mechanism: division of offering equally between morning and evening; measurement by ephah unit
